title: Inspector cell_registry
description: Maps each stable notebook cell_id to what it computes and which atomic claim ids it substantiates. The forward index from the reproducible notebook to the page's claims; the inverse of verify_map[id].cell_id. See _doc.

_about.description: A free-text description of the registry: which source script feeds which cell, and any claims attached to a cell by hand rather than by a script's calculation reference.

purpose.const: cell_registry.json declares, per reproducible-notebook cell, what the cell computes and which atomic claim ids (ana_*/det_*/...) it backs. It lets the Inspector and an auditor cross-check that every published claim is reproduced by some cell and that no cell is orphaned.

inverse_relationship.const: backs[] is the INVERSE of verify_map[id].cell_id: if verify_map['ana_01'].cell_id == 'cell_findings', then cell_registry['cell_findings'].backs must contain 'ana_01'. A consistency check should confirm both directions agree.

cell_id_stability.const: Keys are the stable cell tags carried in the notebook (notebook cell metadata.tags). Renaming a tag requires updating both this file and every verify_map[*].cell_id that points at it.

computes.description: Plain-language statement of what this cell does (what it loads/derives, what it asserts against the published artifacts).

backs.description: The atomic claim ids this cell substantiates. Empty [] for setup/intro/close/utility cells that back no specific on-page claim.

needs_network.description: true if running this cell requires the network (mirrors run_cells / verify_map for the same ids).
